ko.title: 탄산음료, 스낵, 그리고 항공권 가격: 펩시코와 델타의 실적 발표가 보여주는 미국인의 소비 현황

segments.src: Two of America's best-known companies report quarterly results back to back this week, and together they offer a useful snapshot of the household budget.
segments.tr: 미국에서 가장 잘 알려진 두 기업이 이번 주 연달아 분기 실적을 발표하며, 이 두 기업의 실적은 가계 예산에 대한 유용한 스냅샷을 제공합니다.

segments.src: PepsiCo is scheduled to report on Thursday, and Delta Air Lines follows on Friday.
segments.tr: 펩시코는 목요일, 델타 항공은 금요일에 실적을 발표할 예정입니다.

segments.src: One sells everyday groceries and snacks.
segments.tr: 한 곳은 일상적인 식료품과 스낵을 판매합니다.

segments.src: The other sells plane tickets.
segments.tr: 다른 한 곳은 항공권을 판매합니다.

segments.src: Reading them side by side can show where families are tightening up and where they are still willing to spend.
segments.tr: 이 두 기업의 실적을 나란히 놓고 보면 가계가 어디에서 지출을 줄이고 어디에서 여전히 지출할 의향이 있는지 알 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Belong Together
segments.tr: ## 왜 이 두 보고서를 함께 봐야 하는가

segments.src: Economists often split household spending into two broad buckets.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 종종 가계 지출을 두 가지 큰 범주로 나눕니다.

segments.src: The first is **staples**: food, drinks and household basics that people buy almost no matter what.
segments.tr: 첫 번째는 **필수재**로, 사람들이 상황에 관계없이 거의 무조건 구매하는 식품, 음료 및 생활 필수품입니다.

segments.src: The second is **discretionary spending**: trips, dining out and other purchases that are easier to postpone.
segments.tr: 두 번째는 **재량적 지출**로, 여행, 외식 등 미루기 쉬운 구매 항목입니다.

segments.src: PepsiCo sits firmly in the first bucket.
segments.tr: 펩시코는 첫 번째 범주에 확고히 자리 잡고 있습니다.

segments.src: Delta sits in the second, though it is also a bellwether for business travel.
segments.tr: 델타는 두 번째 범주에 속하지만, 비즈니스 여행의 선행 지표이기도 합니다.

segments.src: When both companies report in the same week, observers get a rare chance to compare the two sides of the same wallet.
segments.tr: 두 기업이 같은 주에 실적을 발표할 때, 관찰자들은 같은 지갑의 양면을 비교할 수 있는 드문 기회를 얻게 됩니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at PepsiCo
segments.tr: ## 펩시코 실적에서 주목할 점

segments.src: PepsiCo's business spans beverages and snack foods, so its report can say a lot about the grocery aisle.
segments.tr: 펩시코의 사업은 음료와 스낵 식품을 아우르므로, 이 보고서는 식료품 매장에 대해 많은 것을 말해줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Several themes are worth following:
segments.tr: 다음과 같은 몇 가지 주제를 주목할 필요가 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Volume versus price.** Companies can raise revenue by charging more or by selling more. If sales growth comes mostly from higher prices while the number of items sold stays flat or falls, shoppers may be pushing back.
segments.tr: - **판매량 대 가격.** 기업은 가격을 올리거나 더 많이 판매하여 수익을 늘릴 수 있습니다. 매출 성장이 주로 가격 인상에서 나오고 판매된 품목 수가 정체되거나 감소한다면, 소비자들이 반발하고 있을 가능성이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Trading down.** Consumers who feel squeezed may move from name brands to store brands, or from larger multipacks to cheaper options. Commentary on private-label competition and promotions can hint at this shift.
segments.tr: - **저가 제품으로의 전환.** 경제적 압박을 느끼는 소비자는 유명 브랜드에서 자체 브랜드(PB)로, 또는 대용량 묶음 상품에서 더 저렴한 옵션으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 자체 브랜드 경쟁 및 프로모션에 대한 언급은 이러한 변화를 암시할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Channel shifts.** Where people buy matters. Look for remarks on warehouse clubs, discount stores, convenience stores and online grocery.
segments.tr: - **채널 변화.** 사람들이 어디에서 구매하는지가 중요합니다. 창고형 할인점, 할인점, 편의점, 온라인 식료품점에 대한 언급을 살펴보세요.

segments.src: - **Different income groups.** Management teams sometimes describe how lower-income and higher-income households are behaving differently. Those comments can be more revealing than the headline numbers.
segments.tr: - **소득 계층별 차이.** 경영진은 때때로 저소득층과 고소득층 가계가 어떻게 다르게 행동하는지 설명합니다. 그러한 언급은 헤드라인 수치보다 더 많은 것을 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** The company's outlook for the rest of the year often matters more than the quarter just finished. Any change to expectations for sales growth, costs or profit can signal how leadership sees the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **가이던스.** 올해 남은 기간에 대한 회사의 전망은 방금 마감된 분기보다 더 중요한 경우가 많습니다. 매출 성장, 비용 또는 이익에 대한 기대치의 변화는 경영진이 향후 몇 달을 어떻게 보고 있는지 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at Delta
segments.tr: ## 델타 실적에서 주목할 점

segments.src: Airlines are sensitive to the economy, which makes Delta's report a useful read on confidence.
segments.tr: 항공사는 경기에 민감하기 때문에 델타의 보고서는 소비 심리를 읽는 데 유용합니다.

segments.src: Key questions include:
segments.tr: 주요 질문은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Demand for tickets.** Are travelers still booking, and how far ahead? Strong forward bookings generally suggest consumers feel comfortable about their finances.
segments.tr: - **항공권 수요.** 여행객들이 여전히 예약하고 있는지, 그리고 얼마나 미리 예약하는지 확인해야 합니다. 강력한 선행 예약은 일반적으로 소비자들이 자신의 재정 상태에 대해 편안함을 느끼고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: - **Premium versus main cabin.** Delta has leaned heavily on premium seating and loyalty programs. If travelers keep paying for extra legroom and upgrades, it suggests higher-income customers remain willing to spend.
segments.tr: - **프리미엄 좌석 대 일반석.** 델타는 프리미엄 좌석과 로열티 프로그램에 크게 의존해 왔습니다. 여행객들이 계속해서 더 넓은 좌석과 업그레이드 비용을 지불한다면, 이는 고소득 고객들이 여전히 지출할 의향이 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: - **Business and leisure travel.** The mix between corporate trips and vacations can reflect both company budgets and household sentiment.
segments.tr: - **비즈니스 및 레저 여행.** 기업 출장과 휴가 여행의 비중은 기업 예산과 가계 심리를 모두 반영할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Fares and capacity.** How many seats airlines are flying and what they charge for them affects margins. Watch for comments about pricing power.
segments.tr: - **운임 및 공급.** 항공사가 얼마나 많은 좌석을 운항하고 얼마를 청구하는지는 수익성에 영향을 미칩니다. 가격 결정력에 대한 언급을 주목하세요.

segments.src: - **Costs.** Fuel, labor and maintenance all weigh on results. Management commentary on these costs helps explain the outlook.
segments.tr: - **비용.** 연료, 인건비, 유지비는 모두 실적에 부담을 줍니다. 이러한 비용에 대한 경영진의 논평은 전망을 설명하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** As with PepsiCo, the forward-looking statements may move the conversation more than the past quarter's figures.
segments.tr: - **가이던스.** 펩시코와 마찬가지로, 미래 지향적인 진술이 지난 분기의 수치보다 대화의 흐름을 더 많이 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Reading the Two Together
segments.tr: ## 두 보고서를 함께 읽는 법

segments.src: The combination of results can point in several directions:
segments.tr: 두 실적의 조합은 여러 방향을 가리킬 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Cautious at the store, confident in the air.** If snack and beverage volumes soften while travel stays strong, spending may be tilting toward experiences and away from routine purchases, or the strength may be concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 1. **매장에서는 신중하게, 여행에서는 자신 있게.** 스낵 및 음료 판매량은 감소하는데 여행 수요는 강세를 보인다면, 지출이 일상적인 구매에서 경험으로 이동하고 있거나, 고소득 가계에 강세가 집중되어 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Cautious everywhere.** Weak commentary from both companies would suggest broad caution, with families trimming both grocery spending and travel plans.
segments.tr: 2. **모든 곳에서 신중하게.** 두 기업 모두에서 약한 논평이 나온다면, 가계가 식료품 지출과 여행 계획을 모두 줄이는 등 전반적인 신중함을 보이고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: 3. **Resilient everywhere.** Steady demand at both would suggest consumers are still absorbing higher prices without major cutbacks.
segments.tr: 3. **모든 곳에서 회복력 있게.** 두 곳 모두에서 꾸준한 수요가 확인된다면, 소비자들이 큰 폭의 지출 삭감 없이 여전히 더 높은 가격을 감당하고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: 4. **A split consumer.** Many analysts describe a divided economy in which some households spend freely while others stretch each paycheck. Results from both companies could reinforce that picture.
segments.tr: 4. **분열된 소비자.** 많은 분석가들은 일부 가계는 자유롭게 소비하는 반면 다른 가계는 급여를 쪼개 쓰는 양극화된 경제를 설명합니다. 두 기업의 실적은 그러한 상황을 뒷받침할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: No single quarter settles the question.
segments.tr: 단 한 분기의 실적으로 모든 문제가 해결되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Company reports reflect specific products, markets and strategies, and they should be weighed alongside other data such as retail sales, inflation readings, employment figures and consumer sentiment surveys.
segments.tr: 기업 보고서는 특정 제품, 시장 및 전략을 반영하므로 소매 판매, 인플레이션 수치, 고용 지표 및 소비자 심리 조사와 같은 다른 데이터와 함께 고려해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## A Few Cautions for Readers
segments.tr: ## 독자를 위한 몇 가지 주의 사항

segments.src: - **Headlines can mislead.** A beat or miss versus analyst expectations is not the same as a healthy or unhealthy consumer. Look at the details behind the numbers.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인은 오해를 불러일으킬 수 있습니다.** 분석가들의 예상치를 상회하거나 하회하는 것이 소비자가 건강하다거나 건강하지 않다는 것을 의미하지는 않습니다. 수치 뒤의 세부 사항을 살펴보세요.

segments.src: - **Management tone matters, but it is not a forecast.** Executives choose their words carefully, and outlooks can change.
segments.tr: - **경영진의 어조는 중요하지만, 그것이 곧 예측은 아닙니다.** 경영진은 단어를 신중하게 선택하며, 전망은 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **This is context, not advice.** This article is for general information only and is not investment, financial or tax advice. Readers making financial decisions should consult official company filings and a qualified professional.
segments.tr: - **이것은 맥락일 뿐, 조언이 아닙니다.** 이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 투자, 재무 또는 세무 조언이 아닙니다. 재무적 결정을 내리는 독자는 공식적인 기업 공시와 자격을 갖춘 전문가와 상담해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: PepsiCo and Delta may seem to have little in common, but both depend on the same thing: how much households feel able and willing to spend.
segments.tr: 펩시코와 델타는 공통점이 거의 없어 보일 수 있지만, 두 기업 모두 가계가 얼마나 지출할 여력이 있고 의지가 있는지에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: Whether shoppers are choosing cheaper snacks, holding off on flights or still paying up for a better seat, these two reports should give a clearer view of everyday spending decisions heading into the final months of the year.
segments.tr: 소비자가 더 저렴한 스낵을 선택하든, 항공편 예약을 미루든, 아니면 더 나은 좌석을 위해 기꺼이 비용을 지불하든, 이 두 보고서는 연말을 앞두고 일상적인 소비 결정에 대해 더 명확한 시각을 제공할 것입니다.

zh.title: 汽水、零食与机票价格：百事可乐和达美航空的财报揭示了美国人的消费方式

segments.src: Two of America's best-known companies report quarterly results back to back this week, and together they offer a useful snapshot of the household budget.
segments.tr: 本周，美国两家知名公司将先后发布季度财报，它们共同为我们提供了一幅了解家庭预算的有用快照。

segments.src: PepsiCo is scheduled to report on Thursday, and Delta Air Lines follows on Friday.
segments.tr: 百事可乐定于周四发布财报，达美航空紧随其后，将于周五发布。

segments.src: One sells everyday groceries and snacks.
segments.tr: 一家销售日常杂货和零食。

segments.src: The other sells plane tickets.
segments.tr: 另一家销售机票。

segments.src: Reading them side by side can show where families are tightening up and where they are still willing to spend.
segments.tr: 将这两份财报放在一起解读，可以看出家庭在哪些方面缩减开支，在哪些方面仍愿意消费。

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Belong Together
segments.tr: ## 为什么这两份报告应该放在一起看

segments.src: Economists often split household spending into two broad buckets.
segments.tr: 经济学家通常将家庭支出分为两大类。

segments.src: The first is **staples**: food, drinks and household basics that people buy almost no matter what.
segments.tr: 第一类是**必需品**：人们几乎无论如何都会购买的食品、饮料和家庭日用品。

segments.src: The second is **discretionary spending**: trips, dining out and other purchases that are easier to postpone.
segments.tr: 第二类是**可自由支配支出**：旅行、外出就餐以及其他更容易推迟的消费。

segments.src: PepsiCo sits firmly in the first bucket.
segments.tr: 百事可乐稳稳地处于第一类中。

segments.src: Delta sits in the second, though it is also a bellwether for business travel.
segments.tr: 达美航空处于第二类，尽管它也是商务旅行的风向标。

segments.src: When both companies report in the same week, observers get a rare chance to compare the two sides of the same wallet.
segments.tr: 当两家公司在同一周发布财报时，观察人士便获得了一个难得的机会，可以比较同一个钱包的两面。

segments.src: ## What to Watch at PepsiCo
segments.tr: ## 百事可乐财报看点

segments.src: PepsiCo's business spans beverages and snack foods, so its report can say a lot about the grocery aisle.
segments.tr: 百事可乐的业务涵盖饮料和零食，因此其财报能反映出杂货零售领域的很多情况。

segments.src: Several themes are worth following:
segments.tr: 有几个主题值得关注：

segments.src: - **Volume versus price.** Companies can raise revenue by charging more or by selling more. If sales growth comes mostly from higher prices while the number of items sold stays flat or falls, shoppers may be pushing back.
segments.tr: - **销量与价格。** 公司可以通过提高价格或增加销量来增加收入。如果销售增长主要来自价格上涨，而销售数量持平或下降，那么购物者可能正在抵制。

segments.src: - **Trading down.** Consumers who feel squeezed may move from name brands to store brands, or from larger multipacks to cheaper options. Commentary on private-label competition and promotions can hint at this shift.
segments.tr: - **降级消费。** 感到手头紧的消费者可能会从名牌转向自有品牌，或者从大包装转向更便宜的选择。关于自有品牌竞争和促销活动的评论可以暗示这种转变。

segments.src: - **Channel shifts.** Where people buy matters. Look for remarks on warehouse clubs, discount stores, convenience stores and online grocery.
segments.tr: - **渠道转移。** 人们在哪里购买很重要。留意关于仓储式会员店、折扣店、便利店和在线杂货店的评论。

segments.src: - **Different income groups.** Management teams sometimes describe how lower-income and higher-income households are behaving differently. Those comments can be more revealing than the headline numbers.
segments.tr: - **不同收入群体。** 管理团队有时会描述低收入和高收入家庭的行为有何不同。这些评论可能比头条数字更能说明问题。

segments.src: - **Guidance.** The company's outlook for the rest of the year often matters more than the quarter just finished. Any change to expectations for sales growth, costs or profit can signal how leadership sees the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **业绩指引。** 公司对今年剩余时间的展望往往比刚刚结束的季度更重要。对销售增长、成本或利润预期的任何改变，都可能预示着管理层如何看待未来几个月。

segments.src: ## What to Watch at Delta
segments.tr: ## 达美航空财报看点

segments.src: Airlines are sensitive to the economy, which makes Delta's report a useful read on confidence.
segments.tr: 航空公司对经济非常敏感，这使得达美航空的财报成为解读消费者信心的有用读物。

segments.src: Key questions include:
segments.tr: 关键问题包括：

segments.src: - **Demand for tickets.** Are travelers still booking, and how far ahead? Strong forward bookings generally suggest consumers feel comfortable about their finances.
segments.tr: - **机票需求。** 旅客是否仍在预订机票，预订周期有多长？强劲的远期预订通常表明消费者对自己的财务状况感到安心。

segments.src: - **Premium versus main cabin.** Delta has leaned heavily on premium seating and loyalty programs. If travelers keep paying for extra legroom and upgrades, it suggests higher-income customers remain willing to spend.
segments.tr: - **高端舱位与经济舱。** 达美航空非常依赖高端座位和忠诚度计划。如果旅客继续为额外的腿部空间和升舱付费，这表明高收入客户仍然愿意消费。

segments.src: - **Business and leisure travel.** The mix between corporate trips and vacations can reflect both company budgets and household sentiment.
segments.tr: - **商务与休闲旅行。** 公司差旅和度假之间的比例可以反映公司预算和家庭情绪。

segments.src: - **Fares and capacity.** How many seats airlines are flying and what they charge for them affects margins. Watch for comments about pricing power.
segments.tr: - **票价与运力。** 航空公司运营的座位数及其定价会影响利润率。留意关于定价能力的评论。

segments.src: - **Costs.** Fuel, labor and maintenance all weigh on results. Management commentary on these costs helps explain the outlook.
segments.tr: - **成本。** 燃料、劳动力和维护成本都会影响业绩。管理层对这些成本的评论有助于解释前景。

segments.src: - **Guidance.** As with PepsiCo, the forward-looking statements may move the conversation more than the past quarter's figures.
segments.tr: - **业绩指引。** 与百事可乐一样，前瞻性陈述可能比上个季度的数据更能推动市场讨论。

segments.src: ## Reading the Two Together
segments.tr: ## 综合解读两份财报

segments.src: The combination of results can point in several directions:
segments.tr: 两份财报的结合可以指向几个方向：

segments.src: 1. **Cautious at the store, confident in the air.** If snack and beverage volumes soften while travel stays strong, spending may be tilting toward experiences and away from routine purchases, or the strength may be concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 1. **商店消费谨慎，航空出行自信。** 如果零食和饮料销量疲软而旅行需求依然强劲，说明消费可能正向体验倾斜，远离日常购买，或者这种强势主要集中在高收入家庭中。

segments.src: 2. **Cautious everywhere.** Weak commentary from both companies would suggest broad caution, with families trimming both grocery spending and travel plans.
segments.tr: 2. **全面谨慎。** 两家公司若都给出疲软的评论，将表明普遍的谨慎情绪，家庭正在削减杂货支出和旅行计划。

segments.src: 3. **Resilient everywhere.** Steady demand at both would suggest consumers are still absorbing higher prices without major cutbacks.
segments.tr: 3. **全面韧性。** 两者需求稳定将表明消费者仍在消化更高的价格，而没有进行大规模削减。

segments.src: 4. **A split consumer.** Many analysts describe a divided economy in which some households spend freely while others stretch each paycheck. Results from both companies could reinforce that picture.
segments.tr: 4. **分化的消费者。** 许多分析师描述了一个分裂的经济，一些家庭可以自由消费，而另一些家庭则在勉强维持生计。两家公司的结果可能会强化这一图景。

segments.src: No single quarter settles the question.
segments.tr: 没有哪一个季度能解决这个问题。

segments.src: Company reports reflect specific products, markets and strategies, and they should be weighed alongside other data such as retail sales, inflation readings, employment figures and consumer sentiment surveys.
segments.tr: 公司财报反映的是特定的产品、市场和策略，应该结合零售销售、通胀数据、就业数据和消费者信心调查等其他数据来权衡。

segments.src: ## A Few Cautions for Readers
segments.tr: ## 给读者的几点提醒

segments.src: - **Headlines can mislead.** A beat or miss versus analyst expectations is not the same as a healthy or unhealthy consumer. Look at the details behind the numbers.
segments.tr: - **头条新闻可能会误导。** 超过或低于分析师预期并不等同于消费者健康或不健康。请查看数字背后的细节。

segments.src: - **Management tone matters, but it is not a forecast.** Executives choose their words carefully, and outlooks can change.
segments.tr: - **管理层的语气很重要，但不是预测。** 高管们会谨慎选择措辞，前景也可能会发生变化。

segments.src: - **This is context, not advice.** This article is for general information only and is not investment, financial or tax advice. Readers making financial decisions should consult official company filings and a qualified professional.
segments.tr: - **这是背景信息，而非建议。** 本文仅供一般参考，不构成投资、财务或税务建议。做出财务决策的读者应查阅公司官方文件并咨询合格的专业人士。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: PepsiCo and Delta may seem to have little in common, but both depend on the same thing: how much households feel able and willing to spend.
segments.tr: 百事可乐和达美航空看似没什么共同点，但两者都依赖于同一件事：家庭在多大程度上感到有能力且愿意消费。

segments.src: Whether shoppers are choosing cheaper snacks, holding off on flights or still paying up for a better seat, these two reports should give a clearer view of everyday spending decisions heading into the final months of the year.
segments.tr: 无论购物者是选择更便宜的零食、推迟飞行计划，还是继续为更好的座位支付高价，这两份报告都应该能让我们在进入今年最后几个月时，对日常消费决策有更清晰的认识。

hi.title: सोडा, स्नैक्स और सीट की कीमतें: पेप्सिको और डेल्टा की कमाई अमेरिकी खर्च करने के तरीकों के बारे में क्या बताती है

segments.src: Two of America's best-known companies report quarterly results back to back this week, and together they offer a useful snapshot of the household budget.
segments.tr: अमेरिका की दो सबसे प्रसिद्ध कंपनियां इस सप्ताह एक के बाद एक अपनी तिमाही रिपोर्ट पेश कर रही हैं, और साथ मिलकर वे घरेलू बजट की एक उपयोगी झलक पेश करती हैं।

segments.src: PepsiCo is scheduled to report on Thursday, and Delta Air Lines follows on Friday.
segments.tr: पेप्सिको गुरुवार को रिपोर्ट पेश करने वाली है, और डेल्टा एयर लाइन्स शुक्रवार को ऐसा करेगी।

segments.src: One sells everyday groceries and snacks.
segments.tr: एक कंपनी रोजमर्रा का किराना और स्नैक्स बेचती है।

segments.src: The other sells plane tickets.
segments.tr: दूसरी कंपनी हवाई जहाज के टिकट बेचती है।

segments.src: Reading them side by side can show where families are tightening up and where they are still willing to spend.
segments.tr: इन दोनों को एक साथ पढ़ने से पता चल सकता है कि परिवार कहां खर्च कम कर रहे हैं और कहां वे अभी भी खर्च करने के इच्छुक हैं।

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Belong Together
segments.tr: ## ये दो रिपोर्ट एक साथ क्यों मायने रखती हैं

segments.src: Economists often split household spending into two broad buckets.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री अक्सर घरेलू खर्च को दो व्यापक श्रेणियों में बांटते हैं।

segments.src: The first is **staples**: food, drinks and household basics that people buy almost no matter what.
segments.tr: पहली है **स्टेपल्स (staples)**: भोजन, पेय पदार्थ और घरेलू जरूरत की चीजें जिन्हें लोग लगभग हर हाल में खरीदते हैं।

segments.src: The second is **discretionary spending**: trips, dining out and other purchases that are easier to postpone.
segments.tr: दूसरी है **विवेकाधीन खर्च (discretionary spending)**: यात्राएं, बाहर खाना और अन्य खरीदारी जिन्हें टालना आसान होता है।

segments.src: PepsiCo sits firmly in the first bucket.
segments.tr: पेप्सिको मजबूती से पहली श्रेणी में आती है।

segments.src: Delta sits in the second, though it is also a bellwether for business travel.
segments.tr: डेल्टा दूसरी श्रेणी में आती है, हालांकि यह व्यावसायिक यात्राओं के लिए भी एक संकेतक है।

segments.src: When both companies report in the same week, observers get a rare chance to compare the two sides of the same wallet.
segments.tr: जब दोनों कंपनियां एक ही सप्ताह में रिपोर्ट पेश करती हैं, तो पर्यवेक्षकों को एक ही वॉलेट के दो पहलुओं की तुलना करने का दुर्लभ मौका मिलता है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch at PepsiCo
segments.tr: ## पेप्सिको में क्या देखें

segments.src: PepsiCo's business spans beverages and snack foods, so its report can say a lot about the grocery aisle.
segments.tr: पेप्सिको का व्यवसाय पेय पदार्थों और स्नैक फूड तक फैला हुआ है, इसलिए इसकी रिपोर्ट किराने के सामान के बारे में बहुत कुछ बता सकती है।

segments.src: Several themes are worth following:
segments.tr: कई विषयों पर ध्यान देना जरूरी है:

segments.src: - **Volume versus price.** Companies can raise revenue by charging more or by selling more. If sales growth comes mostly from higher prices while the number of items sold stays flat or falls, shoppers may be pushing back.
segments.tr: - **वॉल्यूम बनाम कीमत।** कंपनियां अधिक शुल्क लेकर या अधिक बिक्री करके राजस्व बढ़ा सकती हैं। यदि बिक्री में वृद्धि मुख्य रूप से उच्च कीमतों से आती है जबकि बेची गई वस्तुओं की संख्या स्थिर रहती है या गिरती है, तो खरीदार पीछे हट रहे हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Trading down.** Consumers who feel squeezed may move from name brands to store brands, or from larger multipacks to cheaper options. Commentary on private-label competition and promotions can hint at this shift.
segments.tr: - **सस्ते विकल्पों की ओर रुख।** जो उपभोक्ता दबाव महसूस करते हैं, वे ब्रांडेड उत्पादों से स्टोर ब्रांडों की ओर, या बड़े मल्टीपैक से सस्ते विकल्पों की ओर बढ़ सकते हैं। निजी-लेबल प्रतिस्पर्धा और प्रचार पर टिप्पणी इस बदलाव का संकेत दे सकती है।

segments.src: - **Channel shifts.** Where people buy matters. Look for remarks on warehouse clubs, discount stores, convenience stores and online grocery.
segments.tr: - **चैनल में बदलाव।** लोग कहां से खरीदारी करते हैं, यह मायने रखता है। वेयरहाउस क्लबों, डिस्काउंट स्टोरों, सुविधा स्टोरों और ऑनलाइन किराने की खरीदारी पर टिप्पणियों को देखें।

segments.src: - **Different income groups.** Management teams sometimes describe how lower-income and higher-income households are behaving differently. Those comments can be more revealing than the headline numbers.
segments.tr: - **विभिन्न आय समूह।** प्रबंधन टीमें कभी-कभी बताती हैं कि कम आय वाले और उच्च आय वाले परिवार अलग-अलग व्यवहार कैसे कर रहे हैं। वे टिप्पणियां मुख्य आंकड़ों से अधिक खुलासा करने वाली हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Guidance.** The company's outlook for the rest of the year often matters more than the quarter just finished. Any change to expectations for sales growth, costs or profit can signal how leadership sees the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **गाइडेंस (Guidance)।** वर्ष के बाकी हिस्सों के लिए कंपनी का दृष्टिकोण अक्सर अभी समाप्त हुई तिमाही से अधिक मायने रखता है। बिक्री वृद्धि, लागत या लाभ के लिए अपेक्षाओं में कोई भी बदलाव यह संकेत दे सकता है कि नेतृत्व आने वाले महीनों को कैसे देखता है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch at Delta
segments.tr: ## डेल्टा में क्या देखें

segments.src: Airlines are sensitive to the economy, which makes Delta's report a useful read on confidence.
segments.tr: एयरलाइंस अर्थव्यवस्था के प्रति संवेदनशील होती हैं, जो डेल्टा की रिपोर्ट को विश्वास के स्तर को समझने के लिए एक उपयोगी पाठ बनाती है।

segments.src: Key questions include:
segments.tr: प्रमुख सवालों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Demand for tickets.** Are travelers still booking, and how far ahead? Strong forward bookings generally suggest consumers feel comfortable about their finances.
segments.tr: - **टिकटों की मांग।** क्या यात्री अभी भी बुकिंग कर रहे हैं, और कितनी पहले? मजबूत अग्रिम बुकिंग आमतौर पर यह सुझाव देती है कि उपभोक्ता अपनी वित्तीय स्थिति को लेकर सहज महसूस करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Premium versus main cabin.** Delta has leaned heavily on premium seating and loyalty programs. If travelers keep paying for extra legroom and upgrades, it suggests higher-income customers remain willing to spend.
segments.tr: - **प्रीमियम बनाम मुख्य केबिन।** डेल्टा ने प्रीमियम सीटिंग और लॉयल्टी प्रोग्राम पर बहुत अधिक जोर दिया है। यदि यात्री अतिरिक्त लेगरूम और अपग्रेड के लिए भुगतान करना जारी रखते हैं, तो यह बताता है कि उच्च आय वाले ग्राहक खर्च करने के इच्छुक बने हुए हैं।

segments.src: - **Business and leisure travel.** The mix between corporate trips and vacations can reflect both company budgets and household sentiment.
segments.tr: - **व्यावसायिक और अवकाश यात्रा।** कॉर्पोरेट यात्राओं और छुट्टियों के बीच का मिश्रण कंपनी के बजट और घरेलू भावना दोनों को प्रतिबिंबित कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Fares and capacity.** How many seats airlines are flying and what they charge for them affects margins. Watch for comments about pricing power.
segments.tr: - **किराया और क्षमता।** एयरलाइंस कितनी सीटें उड़ा रही हैं और वे उनके लिए क्या शुल्क लेती हैं, यह मार्जिन को प्रभावित करता है। मूल्य निर्धारण शक्ति के बारे में टिप्पणियों पर नजर रखें।

segments.src: - **Costs.** Fuel, labor and maintenance all weigh on results. Management commentary on these costs helps explain the outlook.
segments.tr: - **लागत।** ईंधन, श्रम और रखरखाव सभी परिणामों पर वजन डालते हैं। इन लागतों पर प्रबंधन की टिप्पणी दृष्टिकोण को समझाने में मदद करती है।

segments.src: - **Guidance.** As with PepsiCo, the forward-looking statements may move the conversation more than the past quarter's figures.
segments.tr: - **गाइडेंस।** पेप्सिको की तरह, भविष्योन्मुखी बयान पिछली तिमाही के आंकड़ों की तुलना में बातचीत को अधिक प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Reading the Two Together
segments.tr: ## दोनों को एक साथ पढ़ना

segments.src: The combination of results can point in several directions:
segments.tr: परिणामों का संयोजन कई दिशाओं की ओर इशारा कर सकता है:

segments.src: 1. **Cautious at the store, confident in the air.** If snack and beverage volumes soften while travel stays strong, spending may be tilting toward experiences and away from routine purchases, or the strength may be concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 1. **स्टोर पर सतर्क, हवा में आश्वस्त।** यदि स्नैक और पेय पदार्थों की मात्रा कम हो जाती है जबकि यात्रा मजबूत बनी रहती है, तो खर्च अनुभवों की ओर झुक सकता है और नियमित खरीदारी से दूर हो सकता है, या यह मजबूती उच्च आय वाले परिवारों के बीच केंद्रित हो सकती है।

segments.src: 2. **Cautious everywhere.** Weak commentary from both companies would suggest broad caution, with families trimming both grocery spending and travel plans.
segments.tr: 2. **हर जगह सतर्क।** दोनों कंपनियों की कमजोर टिप्पणी व्यापक सावधानी का सुझाव देगी, जिसमें परिवार किराने के खर्च और यात्रा योजनाओं दोनों में कटौती कर रहे होंगे।

segments.src: 3. **Resilient everywhere.** Steady demand at both would suggest consumers are still absorbing higher prices without major cutbacks.
segments.tr: 3. **हर जगह लचीला।** दोनों पर स्थिर मांग यह सुझाव देगी कि उपभोक्ता अभी भी बड़ी कटौती के बिना उच्च कीमतों को स्वीकार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: 4. **A split consumer.** Many analysts describe a divided economy in which some households spend freely while others stretch each paycheck. Results from both companies could reinforce that picture.
segments.tr: 4. **विभाजित उपभोक्ता।** कई विश्लेषक एक विभाजित अर्थव्यवस्था का वर्णन करते हैं जिसमें कुछ परिवार खुलकर खर्च करते हैं जबकि अन्य हर वेतन चेक को खींचते हैं। दोनों कंपनियों के परिणाम उस तस्वीर को मजबूत कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: No single quarter settles the question.
segments.tr: कोई भी एक तिमाही इस सवाल का समाधान नहीं करती है।

segments.src: Company reports reflect specific products, markets and strategies, and they should be weighed alongside other data such as retail sales, inflation readings, employment figures and consumer sentiment surveys.

segments.src: ## A Few Cautions for Readers

es.title: Refrescos, aperitivos y precios de los asientos: lo que dicen los resultados de PepsiCo y Delta sobre cómo gastan los estadounidenses

segments.src: Two of America's best-known companies report quarterly results back to back this week, and together they offer a useful snapshot of the household budget.
segments.tr: Dos de las empresas más conocidas de Estados Unidos presentan sus resultados trimestrales consecutivamente esta semana y, juntas, ofrecen una instantánea útil del presupuesto familiar.

segments.src: PepsiCo is scheduled to report on Thursday, and Delta Air Lines follows on Friday.
segments.tr: Está previsto que PepsiCo informe el jueves y Delta Air Lines le siga el viernes.

segments.src: One sells everyday groceries and snacks.
segments.tr: Una vende comestibles y aperitivos de uso diario.

segments.src: The other sells plane tickets.
segments.tr: La otra vende billetes de avión.

segments.src: Reading them side by side can show where families are tightening up and where they are still willing to spend.
segments.tr: Leerlos uno al lado del otro puede mostrar dónde las familias se están apretando el cinturón y dónde todavía están dispuestas a gastar.

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Belong Together
segments.tr: ## Por qué estos dos informes van de la mano

segments.src: Economists often split household spending into two broad buckets.
segments.tr: Los economistas suelen dividir el gasto de los hogares en dos grandes categorías.

segments.src: The first is **staples**: food, drinks and household basics that people buy almost no matter what.
segments.tr: La primera son los **productos básicos**: alimentos, bebidas y artículos esenciales para el hogar que la gente compra casi pase lo que pase.

segments.src: The second is **discretionary spending**: trips, dining out and other purchases that are easier to postpone.
segments.tr: La segunda es el **gasto discrecional**: viajes, cenas fuera de casa y otras compras que son más fáciles de posponer.

segments.src: PepsiCo sits firmly in the first bucket.
segments.tr: PepsiCo se sitúa firmemente en la primera categoría.

segments.src: Delta sits in the second, though it is also a bellwether for business travel.
segments.tr: Delta se encuentra en la segunda, aunque también es un indicador clave de los viajes de negocios.

segments.src: When both companies report in the same week, observers get a rare chance to compare the two sides of the same wallet.
segments.tr: Cuando ambas empresas informan en la misma semana, los observadores tienen una oportunidad poco común de comparar las dos caras de una misma cartera.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at PepsiCo
segments.tr: ## Qué observar en PepsiCo

segments.src: PepsiCo's business spans beverages and snack foods, so its report can say a lot about the grocery aisle.
segments.tr: El negocio de PepsiCo abarca bebidas y aperitivos, por lo que su informe puede decir mucho sobre el pasillo del supermercado.

segments.src: Several themes are worth following:
segments.tr: Varios temas merecen seguimiento:

segments.src: - **Volume versus price.** Companies can raise revenue by charging more or by selling more. If sales growth comes mostly from higher prices while the number of items sold stays flat or falls, shoppers may be pushing back.
segments.tr: - **Volumen frente a precio.** Las empresas pueden aumentar sus ingresos cobrando más o vendiendo más. Si el crecimiento de las ventas proviene principalmente de precios más altos mientras que el número de artículos vendidos se mantiene plano o cae, es posible que los compradores estén oponiendo resistencia.

segments.src: - **Trading down.** Consumers who feel squeezed may move from name brands to store brands, or from larger multipacks to cheaper options. Commentary on private-label competition and promotions can hint at this shift.
segments.tr: - **Cambio a opciones más baratas.** Los consumidores que se sienten presionados pueden pasar de marcas reconocidas a marcas blancas, o de paquetes múltiples más grandes a opciones más económicas. Los comentarios sobre la competencia de marcas blancas y las promociones pueden insinuar este cambio.

segments.src: - **Channel shifts.** Where people buy matters. Look for remarks on warehouse clubs, discount stores, convenience stores and online grocery.
segments.tr: - **Cambios de canal.** Dónde compra la gente importa. Busque comentarios sobre clubes de mayoristas, tiendas de descuento, tiendas de conveniencia y supermercados en línea.

segments.src: - **Different income groups.** Management teams sometimes describe how lower-income and higher-income households are behaving differently. Those comments can be more revealing than the headline numbers.
segments.tr: - **Diferentes grupos de ingresos.** Los equipos directivos a veces describen cómo los hogares de menores y mayores ingresos se están comportando de manera diferente. Esos comentarios pueden ser más reveladores que las cifras principales.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** The company's outlook for the rest of the year often matters more than the quarter just finished. Any change to expectations for sales growth, costs or profit can signal how leadership sees the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **Orientación.** Las perspectivas de la empresa para el resto del año a menudo importan más que el trimestre recién finalizado. Cualquier cambio en las expectativas de crecimiento de ventas, costos o ganancias puede indicar cómo ve la dirección los próximos meses.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at Delta
segments.tr: ## Qué observar en Delta

segments.src: Airlines are sensitive to the economy, which makes Delta's report a useful read on confidence.
segments.tr: Las aerolíneas son sensibles a la economía, lo que convierte al informe de Delta en una lectura útil sobre la confianza.

segments.src: Key questions include:
segments.tr: Las preguntas clave incluyen:

segments.src: - **Demand for tickets.** Are travelers still booking, and how far ahead? Strong forward bookings generally suggest consumers feel comfortable about their finances.
segments.tr: - **Demanda de billetes.** ¿Siguen reservando los viajeros y con cuánta antelación? Las reservas anticipadas sólidas generalmente sugieren que los consumidores se sienten cómodos con sus finanzas.

segments.src: - **Premium versus main cabin.** Delta has leaned heavily on premium seating and loyalty programs. If travelers keep paying for extra legroom and upgrades, it suggests higher-income customers remain willing to spend.
segments.tr: - **Asientos premium frente a cabina principal.** Delta ha apostado fuertemente por los asientos premium y los programas de fidelización. Si los viajeros siguen pagando por espacio adicional para las piernas y mejoras, sugiere que los clientes de mayores ingresos siguen dispuestos a gastar.

segments.src: - **Business and leisure travel.** The mix between corporate trips and vacations can reflect both company budgets and household sentiment.
segments.tr: - **Viajes de negocios y de placer.** La combinación entre viajes corporativos y vacaciones puede reflejar tanto los presupuestos de las empresas como el sentimiento de los hogares.

segments.src: - **Fares and capacity.** How many seats airlines are flying and what they charge for them affects margins. Watch for comments about pricing power.
segments.tr: - **Tarifas y capacidad.** Cuántos asientos vuelan las aerolíneas y qué cobran por ellos afecta los márgenes. Esté atento a los comentarios sobre el poder de fijación de precios.

segments.src: - **Costs.** Fuel, labor and maintenance all weigh on results. Management commentary on these costs helps explain the outlook.
segments.tr: - **Costos.** El combustible, la mano de obra y el mantenimiento pesan sobre los resultados. Los comentarios de la dirección sobre estos costos ayudan a explicar las perspectivas.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** As with PepsiCo, the forward-looking statements may move the conversation more than the past quarter's figures.
segments.tr: - **Orientación.** Al igual que con PepsiCo, las declaraciones prospectivas pueden mover la conversación más que las cifras del trimestre pasado.

segments.src: ## Reading the Two Together
segments.tr: ## Leer los dos juntos

segments.src: The combination of results can point in several directions:
segments.tr: La combinación de resultados puede apuntar en varias direcciones:

segments.src: 1. **Cautious at the store, confident in the air.** If snack and beverage volumes soften while travel stays strong, spending may be tilting toward experiences and away from routine purchases, or the strength may be concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 1. **Cautela en la tienda, confianza en el aire.** Si los volúmenes de aperitivos y bebidas se suavizan mientras los viajes se mantienen fuertes, el gasto puede estar inclinándose hacia experiencias y alejándose de las compras rutinarias, o la fortaleza puede estar concentrada entre los hogares de mayores ingresos.

segments.src: 2. **Cautious everywhere.** Weak commentary from both companies would suggest broad caution, with families trimming both grocery spending and travel plans.
segments.tr: 2. **Cautela en todas partes.** Los comentarios débiles de ambas compañías sugerirían una cautela generalizada, con las familias recortando tanto el gasto en comestibles como los planes de viaje.

segments.src: 3. **Resilient everywhere.** Steady demand at both would suggest consumers are still absorbing higher prices without major cutbacks.
segments.tr: 3. **Resistencia en todas partes.** Una demanda constante en ambas sugeriría que los consumidores aún están absorbiendo precios más altos sin recortes importantes.

segments.src: 4. **A split consumer.** Many analysts describe a divided economy in which some households spend freely while others stretch each paycheck. Results from both companies could reinforce that picture.
segments.tr: 4. **Un consumidor dividido.** Muchos analistas describen una economía dividida en la que algunos hogares gastan libremente mientras otros estiran cada salario. Los resultados de ambas compañías podrían reforzar ese panorama.

segments.src: No single quarter settles the question.
segments.tr: Ningún trimestre por sí solo resuelve la cuestión.

segments.src: Company reports reflect specific products, markets and strategies, and they should be weighed alongside other data such as retail sales, inflation readings, employment figures and consumer sentiment surveys.
segments.tr: Los informes de las empresas reflejan productos, mercados y estrategias específicos, y deben sopesarse junto con otros datos como las ventas minoristas, las lecturas de inflación, las cifras de empleo y las encuestas de confianza del consumidor.

segments.src: ## A Few Cautions for Readers
segments.tr: ## Algunas advertencias para los lectores

segments.src: - **Headlines can mislead.** A beat or miss versus analyst expectations is not the same as a healthy or unhealthy consumer. Look at the details behind the numbers.
segments.tr: - **Los titulares pueden engañar.** Superar o no alcanzar las expectativas de los analistas no es lo mismo que tener un consumidor sano o no saludable. Mire los detalles detrás de los números.

segments.src: - **Management tone matters, but it is not a forecast.** Executives choose their words carefully, and outlooks can change.
segments.tr: - **El tono de la dirección importa, pero no es un pronóstico.** Los ejecutivos eligen sus palabras cuidadosamente y las perspectivas pueden cambiar.

Los lectores que tomen decisiones financieras deben consultar las presentaciones oficiales de la empresa y a un profesional calificado.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: PepsiCo and Delta may seem to have little in common, but both depend on the same thing: how much households feel able and willing to spend.
segments.tr: Puede parecer que PepsiCo y Delta tienen poco en común, pero ambas dependen de lo mismo: cuánto sienten los hogares que pueden y están dispuestos a gastar.

segments.src: Two of America's best-known companies report quarterly results back to back this week, and together they offer a useful snapshot of the household budget.
segments.tr: Deux des entreprises les plus connues d'Amérique publient leurs résultats trimestriels à tour de rôle cette semaine, et ensemble, elles offrent un aperçu utile du budget des ménages.

segments.src: PepsiCo is scheduled to report on Thursday, and Delta Air Lines follows on Friday.

segments.src: One sells everyday groceries and snacks.

segments.src: The other sells plane tickets.
segments.tr: L'autre vend des billets d'avion.

segments.src: Reading them side by side can show where families are tightening up and where they are still willing to spend.
segments.tr: Les lire côte à côte peut montrer où les familles font des efforts et où elles sont encore prêtes à dépenser.

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Belong Together
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ces deux rapports vont de pair

segments.src: Economists often split household spending into two broad buckets.
segments.tr: Les économistes divisent souvent les dépenses des ménages en deux grandes catégories.

segments.src: The first is **staples**: food, drinks and household basics that people buy almost no matter what.
segments.tr: La première est constituée des **produits de première nécessité** : nourriture, boissons et produits de base que les gens achètent presque quoi qu'il arrive.

segments.src: The second is **discretionary spending**: trips, dining out and other purchases that are easier to postpone.
segments.tr: La seconde concerne les **dépenses discrétionnaires** : voyages, sorties au restaurant et autres achats qu'il est plus facile de reporter.

segments.src: PepsiCo sits firmly in the first bucket.
segments.tr: PepsiCo se situe fermement dans la première catégorie.

segments.src: Delta sits in the second, though it is also a bellwether for business travel.
segments.tr: Delta se trouve dans la seconde, bien qu'elle soit aussi un baromètre des voyages d'affaires.

segments.src: When both companies report in the same week, observers get a rare chance to compare the two sides of the same wallet.
segments.tr: Lorsque les deux entreprises publient leurs résultats la même semaine, les observateurs ont une chance rare de comparer les deux faces d'un même portefeuille.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at PepsiCo
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller chez PepsiCo

segments.src: PepsiCo's business spans beverages and snack foods, so its report can say a lot about the grocery aisle.
segments.tr: L'activité de PepsiCo englobe les boissons et les snacks, son rapport peut donc en dire long sur le rayon épicerie.

segments.src: Several themes are worth following:
segments.tr: Plusieurs thèmes méritent d'être suivis :

segments.src: - **Volume versus price.** Companies can raise revenue by charging more or by selling more. If sales growth comes mostly from higher prices while the number of items sold stays flat or falls, shoppers may be pushing back.
segments.tr: - **Volume par rapport au prix.** Les entreprises peuvent augmenter leurs revenus en facturant plus cher ou en vendant davantage. Si la croissance des ventes provient principalement de prix plus élevés alors que le nombre d'articles vendus stagne ou diminue, les acheteurs font peut-être de la résistance.

segments.src: - **Trading down.** Consumers who feel squeezed may move from name brands to store brands, or from larger multipacks to cheaper options. Commentary on private-label competition and promotions can hint at this shift.
segments.tr: - **Rétrogradation (trading down).** Les consommateurs qui se sentent pressés peuvent passer des marques nationales aux marques de distributeur, ou des grands formats multiples à des options moins chères. Les commentaires sur la concurrence des marques de distributeur et les promotions peuvent laisser deviner ce changement.

segments.src: - **Channel shifts.** Where people buy matters. Look for remarks on warehouse clubs, discount stores, convenience stores and online grocery.
segments.tr: - **Changements de canaux.** L'endroit où les gens achètent a son importance. Recherchez les remarques sur les clubs-entrepôts, les magasins discount, les supérettes et l'épicerie en ligne.

segments.src: - **Different income groups.** Management teams sometimes describe how lower-income and higher-income households are behaving differently. Those comments can be more revealing than the headline numbers.
segments.tr: - **Différents groupes de revenus.** Les équipes de direction décrivent parfois comment les ménages à faible revenu et à revenu élevé se comportent différemment. Ces commentaires peuvent être plus révélateurs que les chiffres principaux.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** The company's outlook for the rest of the year often matters more than the quarter just finished. Any change to expectations for sales growth, costs or profit can signal how leadership sees the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **Prévisions (guidance).** Les perspectives de l'entreprise pour le reste de l'année comptent souvent plus que le trimestre qui vient de s'achever. Tout changement dans les prévisions de croissance des ventes, de coûts ou de bénéfices peut indiquer comment la direction perçoit les mois à venir.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at Delta
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller chez Delta

segments.src: Airlines are sensitive to the economy, which makes Delta's report a useful read on confidence.
segments.tr: Les compagnies aériennes sont sensibles à l'économie, ce qui fait du rapport de Delta une lecture utile de la confiance.

segments.src: Key questions include:
segments.tr: Les questions clés incluent :

segments.src: - **Demand for tickets.** Are travelers still booking, and how far ahead? Strong forward bookings generally suggest consumers feel comfortable about their finances.
segments.tr: - **Demande de billets.** Les voyageurs réservent-ils toujours, et combien de temps à l'avance ? Des réservations anticipées solides suggèrent généralement que les consommateurs se sentent en confiance concernant leurs finances.

segments.src: - **Premium versus main cabin.** Delta has leaned heavily on premium seating and loyalty programs. If travelers keep paying for extra legroom and upgrades, it suggests higher-income customers remain willing to spend.
segments.tr: - **Classe premium par rapport à la cabine principale.** Delta s'est fortement appuyée sur les sièges premium et les programmes de fidélité. Si les voyageurs continuent de payer pour un espace supplémentaire pour les jambes et des surclassements, cela suggère que les clients aux revenus les plus élevés restent disposés à dépenser.

segments.src: - **Business and leisure travel.** The mix between corporate trips and vacations can reflect both company budgets and household sentiment.
segments.tr: - **Voyages d'affaires et de loisirs.** Le mélange entre voyages d'entreprise et vacances peut refléter à la fois les budgets des entreprises et le moral des ménages.

segments.src: - **Fares and capacity.** How many seats airlines are flying and what they charge for them affects margins. Watch for comments about pricing power.
segments.tr: - **Tarifs et capacité.** Le nombre de sièges que les compagnies aériennes font voler et ce qu'elles facturent pour ceux-ci affectent les marges. Surveillez les commentaires sur le pouvoir de fixation des prix.

segments.src: - **Costs.** Fuel, labor and maintenance all weigh on results. Management commentary on these costs helps explain the outlook.
segments.tr: - **Coûts.** Le carburant, la main-d'œuvre et la maintenance pèsent tous sur les résultats. Les commentaires de la direction sur ces coûts aident à expliquer les perspectives.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** As with PepsiCo, the forward-looking statements may move the conversation more than the past quarter's figures.
segments.tr: - **Prévisions (guidance).** Comme pour PepsiCo, les déclarations prospectives peuvent animer la conversation plus que les chiffres du trimestre écoulé.

in.title: Soda, Camilan, dan Harga Kursi: Apa yang Dikatakan Laporan Keuangan PepsiCo dan Delta Tentang Cara Orang Amerika Berbelanja

segments.src: Two of America's best-known companies report quarterly results back to back this week, and together they offer a useful snapshot of the household budget.
segments.tr: Dua perusahaan paling terkenal di Amerika melaporkan hasil kuartalan mereka secara berturut-turut minggu ini, dan bersama-sama mereka menawarkan gambaran yang berguna tentang anggaran rumah tangga.

segments.src: One sells everyday groceries and snacks.
segments.tr: Yang satu menjual bahan makanan dan camilan sehari-hari.

segments.src: The other sells plane tickets.
segments.tr: Yang lainnya menjual tiket pesawat.

segments.src: Reading them side by side can show where families are tightening up and where they are still willing to spend.
segments.tr: Membaca keduanya secara berdampingan dapat menunjukkan di mana keluarga mulai berhemat dan di mana mereka masih bersedia untuk berbelanja.

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Belong Together
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kedua Laporan Ini Perlu Dilihat Bersama

segments.src: Economists often split household spending into two broad buckets.
segments.tr: Para ekonom sering membagi pengeluaran rumah tangga ke dalam dua kelompok besar.

segments.src: The first is **staples**: food, drinks and household basics that people buy almost no matter what.
segments.tr: Yang pertama adalah **kebutuhan pokok**: makanan, minuman, dan kebutuhan rumah tangga yang dibeli orang hampir dalam kondisi apa pun.

segments.src: The second is **discretionary spending**: trips, dining out and other purchases that are easier to postpone.
segments.tr: Yang kedua adalah **pengeluaran diskresioner**: perjalanan, makan di luar, dan pembelian lain yang lebih mudah untuk ditunda.

segments.src: PepsiCo sits firmly in the first bucket.
segments.tr: PepsiCo berada dengan kuat di kelompok pertama.

segments.src: Delta sits in the second, though it is also a bellwether for business travel.
segments.tr: Delta berada di kelompok kedua, meskipun juga merupakan indikator untuk perjalanan bisnis.

segments.src: When both companies report in the same week, observers get a rare chance to compare the two sides of the same wallet.
segments.tr: Ketika kedua perusahaan melapor di minggu yang sama, para pengamat mendapatkan kesempatan langka untuk membandingkan dua sisi dari dompet yang sama.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at PepsiCo
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan di PepsiCo

segments.src: PepsiCo's business spans beverages and snack foods, so its report can say a lot about the grocery aisle.
segments.tr: Bisnis PepsiCo mencakup minuman dan makanan ringan, jadi laporannya dapat memberikan banyak informasi tentang lorong bahan makanan.

segments.src: Several themes are worth following:
segments.tr: Beberapa tema layak untuk diikuti:

segments.src: - **Volume versus price.** Companies can raise revenue by charging more or by selling more. If sales growth comes mostly from higher prices while the number of items sold stays flat or falls, shoppers may be pushing back.
segments.tr: - **Volume versus harga.** Perusahaan dapat meningkatkan pendapatan dengan menaikkan harga atau dengan menjual lebih banyak. Jika pertumbuhan penjualan sebagian besar berasal dari harga yang lebih tinggi sementara jumlah barang yang terjual tetap atau turun, pembeli mungkin mulai menolak.

segments.src: - **Trading down.** Consumers who feel squeezed may move from name brands to store brands, or from larger multipacks to cheaper options. Commentary on private-label competition and promotions can hint at this shift.
segments.tr: - **Beralih ke produk lebih murah.** Konsumen yang merasa tertekan mungkin beralih dari merek ternama ke merek toko, atau dari kemasan multipak yang lebih besar ke pilihan yang lebih murah. Komentar tentang persaingan label pribadi dan promosi dapat mengisyaratkan pergeseran ini.

segments.src: - **Channel shifts.** Where people buy matters. Look for remarks on warehouse clubs, discount stores, convenience stores and online grocery.
segments.tr: - **Pergeseran saluran.** Di mana orang membeli itu penting. Perhatikan komentar tentang klub gudang, toko diskon, toko serba ada, dan bahan makanan daring.

segments.src: - **Different income groups.** Management teams sometimes describe how lower-income and higher-income households are behaving differently. Those comments can be more revealing than the headline numbers.
segments.tr: - **Kelompok pendapatan yang berbeda.** Tim manajemen terkadang menjelaskan bagaimana rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah dan berpenghasilan tinggi berperilaku secara berbeda. Komentar tersebut bisa lebih mengungkapkan daripada angka utama.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** The company's outlook for the rest of the year often matters more than the quarter just finished. Any change to expectations for sales growth, costs or profit can signal how leadership sees the months ahead.
segments.tr: - **Panduan.** Prospek perusahaan untuk sisa tahun ini sering kali lebih penting daripada kuartal yang baru saja berakhir. Setiap perubahan pada ekspektasi untuk pertumbuhan penjualan, biaya, atau laba dapat memberi sinyal bagaimana kepemimpinan melihat bulan-bulan mendatang.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at Delta
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan di Delta

segments.src: Airlines are sensitive to the economy, which makes Delta's report a useful read on confidence.
segments.tr: Maskapai penerbangan sensitif terhadap ekonomi, yang membuat laporan Delta menjadi bacaan yang berguna tentang kepercayaan.

segments.src: Key questions include:
segments.tr: Pertanyaan kunci meliputi:

segments.src: - **Demand for tickets.** Are travelers still booking, and how far ahead? Strong forward bookings generally suggest consumers feel comfortable about their finances.
segments.tr: - **Permintaan tiket.** Apakah wisatawan masih memesan, dan seberapa jauh ke depan? Pemesanan ke depan yang kuat umumnya menunjukkan bahwa konsumen merasa nyaman dengan keuangan mereka.

segments.src: - **Premium versus main cabin.** Delta has leaned heavily on premium seating and loyalty programs. If travelers keep paying for extra legroom and upgrades, it suggests higher-income customers remain willing to spend.
segments.tr: - **Premium versus kabin utama.** Delta sangat mengandalkan tempat duduk premium dan program loyalitas. Jika wisatawan terus membayar untuk ruang kaki ekstra dan peningkatan kelas, itu menunjukkan bahwa pelanggan berpenghasilan tinggi tetap bersedia untuk berbelanja.

segments.src: - **Business and leisure travel.** The mix between corporate trips and vacations can reflect both company budgets and household sentiment.
segments.tr: - **Perjalanan bisnis dan liburan.** Perpaduan antara perjalanan perusahaan dan liburan dapat mencerminkan anggaran perusahaan dan sentimen rumah tangga.

segments.src: - **Fares and capacity.** How many seats airlines are flying and what they charge for them affects margins. Watch for comments about pricing power.
segments.tr: - **Tarif dan kapasitas.** Berapa banyak kursi yang diterbangkan maskapai dan berapa harga yang mereka tetapkan untuk kursi tersebut memengaruhi margin. Perhatikan komentar tentang kekuatan penetapan harga.

segments.src: - **Costs.** Fuel, labor and maintenance all weigh on results. Management commentary on these costs helps explain the outlook.
segments.tr: - **Biaya.** Bahan bakar, tenaga kerja, dan pemeliharaan semuanya membebani hasil. Komentar manajemen tentang biaya-biaya ini membantu menjelaskan prospeknya.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** As with PepsiCo, the forward-looking statements may move the conversation more than the past quarter's figures.
segments.tr: - **Panduan.** Seperti halnya PepsiCo, pernyataan berwawasan ke depan mungkin lebih menggerakkan percakapan daripada angka-angka kuartal lalu.

segments.src: ## Reading the Two Together
segments.tr: ## Membaca Keduanya Bersama-sama

segments.src: The combination of results can point in several directions:
segments.tr: Kombinasi hasil dapat mengarah ke beberapa arah:

segments.src: 1. **Cautious at the store, confident in the air.** If snack and beverage volumes soften while travel stays strong, spending may be tilting toward experiences and away from routine purchases, or the strength may be concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 1. **Berhati-hati di toko, percaya diri di udara.** Jika volume camilan dan minuman melunak sementara perjalanan tetap kuat, pengeluaran mungkin condong ke arah pengalaman dan menjauh dari pembelian rutin, atau kekuatannya mungkin terkonsentrasi di antara rumah tangga berpenghasilan tinggi.

segments.src: 2. **Cautious everywhere.** Weak commentary from both companies would suggest broad caution, with families trimming both grocery spending and travel plans.
segments.tr: 2. **Berhati-hati di mana-mana.** Komentar lemah dari kedua perusahaan akan menunjukkan kehati-hatian yang luas, dengan keluarga memangkas pengeluaran bahan makanan dan rencana perjalanan.

segments.src: 3. **Resilient everywhere.** Steady demand at both would suggest consumers are still absorbing higher prices without major cutbacks.
segments.tr: 3. **Tangguh di mana-mana.** Permintaan yang stabil di keduanya akan menunjukkan bahwa konsumen masih menyerap harga yang lebih tinggi tanpa pengurangan besar.

segments.src: 4. **A split consumer.** Many analysts describe a divided economy in which some households spend freely while others stretch each paycheck. Results from both companies could reinforce that picture.
segments.tr: 4. **Konsumen yang terbelah.** Banyak analis menggambarkan ekonomi yang terbagi di mana beberapa rumah tangga berbelanja dengan bebas sementara yang lain harus menghemat setiap gaji. Hasil dari kedua perusahaan dapat memperkuat gambaran tersebut.

segments.src: No single quarter settles the question.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu kuartal pun yang menyelesaikan pertanyaan tersebut.

segments.src: Company reports reflect specific products, markets and strategies, and they should be weighed alongside other data such as retail sales, inflation readings, employment figures and consumer sentiment surveys.
segments.tr: Laporan perusahaan mencerminkan produk, pasar, dan strategi tertentu, dan harus ditimbang bersama data lain seperti penjualan ritel, pembacaan inflasi, angka ketenagakerjaan, dan survei sentimen konsumen.

segments.src: ## A Few Cautions for Readers

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Belong Together

segments.src: Economists often split household spending into two broad buckets.

segments.src: The first is **staples**: food, drinks and household basics that people buy almost no matter what.
segments.tr: Der erste sind **Güter des täglichen Bedarfs**: Lebensmittel, Getränke und Haushaltswaren, die die Menschen fast unabhängig von den Umständen kaufen.

segments.src: The second is **discretionary spending**: trips, dining out and other purchases that are easier to postpone.

segments.src: ## What to Watch at PepsiCo

segments.src: Several themes are worth following:

segments.src: - **Volume versus price.** Companies can raise revenue by charging more or by selling more. If sales growth comes mostly from higher prices while the number of items sold stays flat or falls, shoppers may be pushing back.

segments.src: - **Trading down.** Consumers who feel squeezed may move from name brands to store brands, or from larger multipacks to cheaper options. Commentary on private-label competition and promotions can hint at this shift.
segments.tr: - **Downshifting.** Verbraucher, die sich unter Druck fühlen, wechseln möglicherweise von bekannten Marken zu Handelsmarken oder von größeren Multipacks zu günstigeren Optionen. Kommentare zur Konkurrenz durch Eigenmarken und Werbeaktionen können auf diesen Wandel hindeuten.

segments.src: - **Channel shifts.** Where people buy matters. Look for remarks on warehouse clubs, discount stores, convenience stores and online grocery.
segments.tr: - **Vertriebskanalwechsel.** Wo Menschen einkaufen, spielt eine Rolle. Achten Sie auf Bemerkungen zu Großmärkten, Discountern, Convenience-Stores und Online-Lebensmittelhandel.

segments.src: - **Different income groups.** Management teams sometimes describe how lower-income and higher-income households are behaving differently. Those comments can be more revealing than the headline numbers.
segments.tr: - **Verschiedene Einkommensgruppen.** Managementteams beschreiben manchmal, wie sich Haushalte mit niedrigerem und höherem Einkommen unterschiedlich verhalten. Diese Kommentare können aufschlussreicher sein als die Schlagzeilenzahlen.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** The company's outlook for the rest of the year often matters more than the quarter just finished. Any change to expectations for sales growth, costs or profit can signal how leadership sees the months ahead.

segments.src: - **Premium versus main cabin.** Delta has leaned heavily on premium seating and loyalty programs. If travelers keep paying for extra legroom and upgrades, it suggests higher-income customers remain willing to spend.

segments.tr: - **Kosten.** Treibstoff, Arbeitskräfte und Wartung belasten die Ergebnisse. Kommentare des Managements zu diesen Kosten helfen, den Ausblick zu erklären.

segments.src: - **Fares and capacity.** How many seats airlines are flying and what they charge for them affects margins. Watch for comments about pricing power.
segments.tr: - **Giá vé và công suất.** Có bao nhiêu ghế các hãng hàng không đang bay và những gì họ tính phí cho chúng ảnh hưởng đến biên lợi nhuận. Hãy chú ý đến các nhận xét về quyền lực định giá.

segments.src: - **Costs.** Fuel, labor and maintenance all weigh on results. Management commentary on these costs helps explain the outlook.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí.** Nhiên liệu, nhân công và bảo trì đều đè nặng lên kết quả. Bình luận của ban quản lý về các chi phí này giúp giải thích triển vọng.

segments.src: - **Guidance.** As with PepsiCo, the forward-looking statements may move the conversation more than the past quarter's figures.
segments.tr: - **Hướng dẫn.** Giống như PepsiCo, các tuyên bố hướng về tương lai có thể thúc đẩy cuộc trò chuyện nhiều hơn là các số liệu của quý trước.

segments.src: ## Reading the Two Together
segments.tr: ## Đọc hai báo cáo cùng nhau

segments.src: The combination of results can point in several directions:
segments.tr: Sự kết hợp của các kết quả có thể chỉ ra theo nhiều hướng:

segments.src: 1. **Cautious at the store, confident in the air.** If snack and beverage volumes soften while travel stays strong, spending may be tilting toward experiences and away from routine purchases, or the strength may be concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: 1. **Thận trọng tại cửa hàng, tự tin trên không.** Nếu khối lượng đồ ăn nhẹ và đồ uống giảm sút trong khi du lịch vẫn mạnh mẽ, chi tiêu có thể đang nghiêng về trải nghiệm và rời xa các giao dịch mua sắm thông thường, hoặc sức mạnh có thể tập trung ở các hộ gia đình có thu nhập cao.

segments.src: 2. **Cautious everywhere.** Weak commentary from both companies would suggest broad caution, with families trimming both grocery spending and travel plans.
segments.tr: 2. **Thận trọng ở mọi nơi.** Bình luận yếu kém từ cả hai công ty sẽ cho thấy sự thận trọng trên diện rộng, với các gia đình cắt giảm cả chi tiêu tạp hóa và kế hoạch du lịch.

segments.src: 3. **Resilient everywhere.** Steady demand at both would suggest consumers are still absorbing higher prices without major cutbacks.
segments.tr: 3. **Kiên cường ở mọi nơi.** Nhu cầu ổn định ở cả hai sẽ cho thấy người tiêu dùng vẫn đang hấp thụ giá cao hơn mà không có sự cắt giảm lớn.

segments.src: 4. **A split consumer.** Many analysts describe a divided economy in which some households spend freely while others stretch each paycheck. Results from both companies could reinforce that picture.
segments.tr: 4. **Người tiêu dùng bị chia rẽ.** Nhiều nhà phân tích mô tả một nền kinh tế bị chia rẽ, trong đó một số hộ gia đình chi tiêu tự do trong khi những người khác phải chật vật với từng tấm séc lương. Kết quả từ cả hai công ty có thể củng cố bức tranh đó.

segments.src: No single quarter settles the question.
segments.tr: Không có một quý đơn lẻ nào giải quyết được vấn đề.

segments.src: Company reports reflect specific products, markets and strategies, and they should be weighed alongside other data such as retail sales, inflation readings, employment figures and consumer sentiment surveys.
segments.tr: Báo cáo của công ty phản ánh các sản phẩm, thị trường và chiến lược cụ thể, và chúng nên được cân nhắc cùng với các dữ liệu khác như doanh số bán lẻ, chỉ số lạm phát, số liệu việc làm và các cuộc khảo sát tâm lý người tiêu dùng.

segments.src: ## A Few Cautions for Readers
segments.tr: ## Một số lưu ý cho người đọc

segments.src: - **Headlines can mislead.** A beat or miss versus analyst expectations is not the same as a healthy or unhealthy consumer. Look at the details behind the numbers.
segments.tr: - **Tiêu đề có thể đánh lạc hướng.** Vượt qua hoặc hụt so với kỳ vọng của nhà phân tích không có nghĩa là người tiêu dùng khỏe mạnh hay không khỏe mạnh. Hãy nhìn vào các chi tiết đằng sau các con số.

segments.src: - **Management tone matters, but it is not a forecast.** Executives choose their words carefully, and outlooks can change.
segments.tr: - **Giọng điệu của ban quản lý rất quan trọng, nhưng nó không phải là dự báo.** Các giám đốc điều hành chọn từ ngữ của họ một cách cẩn thận, và triển vọng có thể thay đổi.

segments.src: - **This is context, not advice.** This article is for general information only and is not investment, financial or tax advice. Readers making financial decisions should consult official company filings and a qualified professional.
segments.tr: - **Đây là bối cảnh, không phải lời khuyên.** Bài viết này chỉ dành cho mục đích thông tin chung và không phải là lời khuyên đầu tư, tài chính hoặc thuế. Người đọc đưa ra quyết định tài chính nên tham khảo các hồ sơ chính thức của công ty và một chuyên gia đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: PepsiCo and Delta may seem to have little in common, but both depend on the same thing: how much households feel able and willing to spend.
segments.tr: PepsiCo và Delta có vẻ có rất ít điểm chung, nhưng cả hai đều phụ thuộc vào cùng một điều: các hộ gia đình cảm thấy có khả năng và sẵn sàng chi tiêu đến mức nào.

segments.src: Whether shoppers are choosing cheaper snacks, holding off on flights or still paying up for a better seat, these two reports should give a clearer view of everyday spending decisions heading into the final months of the year.
segments.tr: Cho dù người mua sắm đang chọn đồ ăn nhẹ rẻ hơn, trì hoãn các chuyến bay hay vẫn trả tiền cho một chỗ ngồi tốt hơn, hai báo cáo này sẽ cung cấp cái nhìn rõ ràng hơn về các quyết định chi tiêu hàng ngày hướng tới những tháng cuối năm.
